method: Read the 6 new values per locale against English, the English context sidecar, the core glossary, the locale style guide and sibling keys in the same namespaces; mechanically checked placeholders ({name}), key parity/order, untranslated values and absence of bidi control characters (U+200E/F, U+061C, U+202A-E, U+2066-9).
